cohort: 50 women in their third trimester of pregnancy with laterally located minor placenta previa
finding: 3D TVS measurements of edge-to-os distance were shorter than 2D TVS measurements in most (92%) cases of laterally located minor placenta previa, leading to a change in delivery mode from attempted vaginal delivery to elective c-section in 78% of cases.
mod_finding: The decision about mode of delivery was changed from attempt of vaginal delivery to cesarean delivery in 39/50 cases (78%), as 2D distances that were >=20 mm were actually <20 mm by 3D examination in these cases.
